| [SYNTHESIS-017](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-017.md) v2 | What a record of a developing argument can secure is traceable change over its accountability structure, which is neither sufficiency for revision nor correctness: current conclusions and support topology do not fix revisions, a sufficient state makes history redundant only while its model and decisions hold, and what kept justifications can buy is a wider family of decisions and decisions a bounded agent could not otherwise make |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-018](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-018.md) v2 | A corporation can bear functional affect in Frijda's sense, without its implying experience, and so can be read as lacking remorse when others' harms reach its decisions only as threats, a reading Wells Fargo's sales practices document and an unanswered objection says cannot be told from prudence; the functional reading is held back by the identity of valence with a felt state, whether such affect needs a group subject or is fixed by the attributor's concept is open, and the line's first framing, what it is like to be a corporation, is retired |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-019](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-019.md) | The owner's thesis that experience is constituted by interpretive organization stands with its sufficiency condition unstated: interpretation as such does not suffice, current grounding and a represented owner are kept apart from what would make an organization experiential, the line's one candidate condition makes valence felt only in the access sense, and each test of the rest meets the limit that the record's evidence about experience reaches it through access |  | Proposed |

| [SYNTHESIS-022](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-022.md) v2 | Whether organizational affect is felt is held apart from whether it is functional: the binding of a distributed response can be real while the single owner it is attributed to is a self-model's construction, a regime of valence is felt in the sense of attended and available when the system models its own potential, and access within one agent may be compartmented; whether the model that makes valence felt is the one that presents an owner, and whether a state meeting a functional characterization of affect must be felt, are open |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-023](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-023.md) | The authenticity line holds, set aside, that a will is the agent's own to the degree its commitments arise through, remain integrated with and are answerable to its constitutive organization, and that this grounds normativity from a whole to its constituents but not between peers; it was deferred because its ownership criteria do not survive manipulation, and what it has gained since is a candidate content for "integrated", non-domination of the processes that carry a commitment, with the objection that non-domination cannot be read from low supervisory cost, or from override alone, but only under intervention, when a constituent dissents, or from history |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-024](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-024.md) v2 | Reaching a configuration has a resource threshold of its own, the least peak over admissible paths, which can exceed what holding either end takes and is relative to a fixed architecture; feasible, reachable and reliably reached come apart, failures of a transition have distinct remedies, a form needs separate resources to build, keep and move, several resources give a non-convex frontier rather than a total, and a budget set to last period's spending loses every transition that needs slack with no sign in output |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-025](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-025.md) | When a learned distinction becomes a concept is open, and a candidate term holds the record's working answer: a concept is a reusable, consequential pattern of distinctions, distinct from what carries it, what realizes it, what it is about and its corrigibility; the owner's question whether concepts individuate runs against the term's clause that a concept is not a thing; and Proposed claims that rival uses can keep an expression circulating without one concept, and that concepts are individuated by transmission, bear on it, with a proposed study to tell agreement in a concept from agreement in how it is revised |  | Proposed |

| [SYNTHESIS-027](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-027.md) v2 | Readiness for a rare contingency is a probability of effective response under an imposed contingency, which a record of use does not measure, so neither low use nor frequent cancellation shows a reserve to be waste; a capacity is worth what the capacities it works with let it deliver, records kept per capacity bound readiness and do not identify it, and a capability kept for rare events decays unless it is practised outside operation |  | Proposed |
